__Overview__

- Cost: 15 caps
- Production Rate: 5 min (300 seconds) cooldown period.
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: No. Refer to cooldown period

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 1

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Glass
- 1x Gears
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Refer to cooldown period
